subject: Pricing follow-up: target $/1M tokens benchmarking
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: John Cole <john.cole@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + pricing targets (1M token benchmarking)

Hi John, great to chat earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call: 

1) Current usage & goals
- You indicated ~100M model tokens/month across product and experimentation.
- Primary use: real-time assistant (70%) + nightly batch summarization (30%).

2) Pricing sensitivity / target economics
- You mentioned a budget sensitivity and asked for a ballpark target $/1M tokens to be competitive with your current OpenAI spend.
- You called out a target budget range for inference of roughly $3k-6k/month (high level).

3) What I need from you to finalize a proposal
- A more precise monthly active token estimate (min/typical/peak).
- Any SLA or regional constraints (US only is fine).

Next steps
- I will follow up with a short benchmarking note comparing Redwood list pricing vs OpenAI/Anthropic and typical open-model hosts (quantized vs fp16 paths).
- I'll attach a simple spreadsheet with unit economics (tokens - $/1M) and example monthly cost ranges so you can plug in your permutations.

Thanks, copying Marissa and Neha for pricing/discount guidance. Can you confirm the 100M/month baseline and whether the nightly batch has strict latency needs?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Schedule time: https://calendly.com/vanessa-redwood

[Attachment: redwood_pricing_vs_hosts.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: John Cole <john.cole@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + pricing targets (1M token benchmarking)

Vanessa, thanks for the recap, that looks right. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed baseline: 100M tokens/month is a solid typical case. Peak can hit ~180M in promo windows.
- Budget: the current total monthly spend with our incumbent (OpenAI + hosting) is about $12k. We'd like to get Redwood in range so our incremental spend doesn't exceed $8k/month.
- Target price: ideally we'd like to see pricing at or below $30/1M tokens to make the math work given our other platform costs. If Redwood can get to the $20-30/1M range with comparable latency, we'd be very interested.
- Notes: The nightly batch can tolerate higher latency; the real-time assistant requires p95 < 500ms.

We look forward to the benchmarking spreadsheet.

John
John Cole
Head of ML Platforms | Acme Corp
john.cole@acme.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: John Cole <john.cole@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + pricing targets (1M token benchmarking)

Thanks John, this is perfect and very helpful. Summary and next concrete numbers below. I attached the spreadsheet with line-item comparisons; paste of the key benchmark here for quick visibility.

Key benchmarking (examples per 1M model tokens, inference only):
- Redwood (recommended config: quantized LLM, mixed-batching): $22 - $28 / 1M tokens
- OpenAI (public list & blended for your workload): roughly $40 - $55 / 1M tokens
- Anthropic (public list / comparable): roughly $38 - $50 / 1M tokens
- Other open-model hosts (varies by quantization & batching): $18 - $35 / 1M tokens (lower-end requires aggressive quantization or lower SLA)

Notes:
- Redwood range reflects options (reserved vs hosted tier, and QoS). The $22 number assumes a 12-month reserved commit and some batching/prefix cache; $28 is our hosted/top-tier SLA list without commit.
- The "Other hosts" bucket can be cheaper for experimental workloads but often trades off latency and reliability. We call out risk of higher error rates with aggressive quantization for generation quality-sensitive flows.

Estimated monthly cost at your baseline (100M tokens/month):
- Redwood (target): $2.2k - $2.8k / month
- OpenAI (blended): $4.0k - $5.5k / month
- Anthropic (blended): $3.8k - $5.0k / month

This puts Redwood squarely in your target $20-30/1M range and comfortably under your $8k incremental threshold for the 100M baseline. For peak (180M), the arithmetic scales proportionally; reserved commit pricing will further lower unit costs.

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa will prepare a draft term sheet with two options: (A) 12-month reserved commit with blended unit $22/1M and (B) hosted SLA with blended $28/1M.
- Technical deep-dive: Neha to propose an infra call to validate p95 latency and storage/retention settings for KV cache.
- I'll share the HubSpot deal link and the attached spreadsheet so you can model scenarios.

Links & attachments:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4729
- Pricing spreadsheet (attached): redwood_pricing_vs_hosts.xlsx

Could you confirm you're comfortable with the 100M baseline and whether you'd like us to model a 12-month commit vs a trial first? Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Office: +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: redwood_pricing_vs_hosts.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
